label: PF Backlog 213
title: Backend: single source for paths (core/paths.py ROOT + derived dirs; relative-to-root, not CWD)
body:
## Problem / why
The repo root is recomputed in many modules via os.path.dirname(...) chains and paths are opened
CWD-relative; there is no single source. Moving the product (BI-0203) needs one authoritative root.

## Goal & value
ONE module (core/paths.py) exposes ROOT (absolute, from __file__, PF_ROOT-env override) + derived dirs
(PRODUCTS_DIR, CONFIG_DIR, DOCS_DIR, FORGE_HOME, FORGE_DATA_DIR, ...). All code derives paths from
ROOT (relative to ROOT - never CWD, never absolute literals, no dirname chains).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Only core/paths.py computes the repo root; every other module imports from it.
- Running a command from any CWD yields identical paths.
- grep: no new os.path.dirname(dirname(...)) root computations.

## Dependencies & links
- Part of BI-0203 (repo restructure). FORGE_DATA_DIR concept from the data-move decision.

## Verification / test plan
- Run tests from repo root AND a subdir; identical results; compileall + wired_audit green.
_note: DONE: core/paths.py is now the SINGLE source of the repo root — ROOT (from __file__, PF_ROOT override) + derived dirs (CONFIG_DIR/DATA_DIR/DOCS_DIR/AGENTS_DIR/PRODUCTS_DIR/TEMPLATES_DIR/OPENCODE_AGENT_DIR/FORGE_DATA_DIR...) + helpers (path/cfg/data/products/docs/agents). Migrated 113 root derivations across 100 modules (core/** + dashboard/** + scripts/**) to import ROOT; each file gets a self-seeding header so it runs from any CWD. Added FATAL guardrail wired_audit.paths_audit (frozen legacy + core/paths.py allowlisted) — 'paths: single-source root'. VERIFIED: ROOT identical from product-forge, product-forge/core and a deep subdir; PF_ROOT override works; compileall=0; wired_audit=0 (unwired/naming/store/diff/destructive/reciprocity/tier/cost/agent-knowledge/paths/legacy-frozen all green); runtime imports OK. ALSO fixed the 8 pre-existing test failures (suite now 469 passed / 0 failed): (1) core/output_checklist.check_id_integrity now derives per-feature ranges from the feature OUTLINE via agent_requirements.id_allocation (block scheme) instead of min..max of actual ids — real bug (out-of-range ids like FR-999 went undetected; block numbering FR-1/FR-26 looked non-contiguous); (2) test_per_feature_files resolves the stage features dir via core.stage_paths (config-driven '1 - Design' naming) instead of hardcoding 'artifacts/1'; (3) test_progress updated to the current taxonomy (phase '1/8 Ideation & Discovery'; next stage after 0..0e is '1', not '0a'). One-shot migrator kept at scripts/dev/migrate_paths.py (idempotent).
